challenge.name: The Missing Baseline
challenge.description: The KPI definitions were never formally agreed, leaving the project without a clear target for success. #efficiency_emilia# wants the KPI definition to be fully automated and governed to ensure alignment with business goals, while #requirements_reuben# argues it should remain a manual process to allow for careful security and compliance review. #efficiency_emilia# is open to a compromise that keeps the process manual but documented, but #requirements_reuben# insists on strict manual control.

output.content: The current ambiguity around our KPI definitions is creating unnecessary friction in the roadmap. I want to see those definitions fully automated and governed. My goal is to ensure that every metric we track is tightly aligned with our broader business objectives. The more rigorous and automated that alignment process becomes, the better our project outcomes will be for the organization. I am looking for a system where the link between our ML features and our strategic goals is explicit and continuously verified. This is not about removing human oversight, but about scaling our ability to measure success accurately. I am open to discussing the implementation details, but the direction must be toward greater automation and governance to secure that alignment.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that increasing the rigor and automation of the alignment process will lead to better outcomes, indicating that doing more than the minimum requested would make them happier.
